main.description: One spent unit token on a public board: an anonymous ballot. Written by the board account and never by the voter, since a record lives in a repo owned by a DID and a voter's own would name them. It has no field for who cast it, and weighs exactly 1, so the tally is a count of entries per choice. A token seen twice counts once, the first standing (D4). Ballots are not published as they are cast: they go out at least three together and shuffled, or all at the close, and `createdAt` is when the batch left, so that a record's arrival says nothing of when its ballot was cast. Encodings are base64url without padding (`crates/ballot-spec/src/provisional.rs`, pinned by a known-answer vector).

pollRef.description: The poll this ballot belongs to. The strongRef's CID pins the exact poll version (question, options, rules, issuerPubkey) the entry was validated against.

token.description: The unblinded unit token's message, a 32-byte voter-generated random nullifier, as base64url (unpadded). Carries no structure and no identity; its uniqueness on the board is the dedup.

msgRandomizer.description: The RFC 9474 message randomizer from blinding (the RSABSSA Randomized variant), base64url (unpadded). Optional per the spec crate's shape; required by verification when present at signing.

signature.description: The unblinded RSA-PSS signature over token, base64url (unpadded). Verifies under the referenced poll's published issuerPubkey; per-poll keys make cross-poll spends unverifiable.

choices.description: Selected option indices into the poll's options array, subject to the poll's minVote, maxVote, and blank rules.

createdAt.description: When the batch this ballot went out in left, the same for all of it. Not when it was cast.
